html:
Table. Table 2 from rem:schrodinger-color-falsifiability

Fitted \eta Verdict on the direct q_0 \leftrightarrow \text{color} identification
\eta \in [0.08, 0.13] Confirmation. The substrate parameter q_0 predicts macroscopic color perception with no rescaling.
\eta \in [0.02, 0.50] but outside [0.08, 0.13] Refinement. A scale renormalization q_{\mathrm{color}} = q_0^{\,\alpha} between substrate and retinal cone-cell physics is required. The exponent \alpha derives from the cone-spectral-response cascade.
\eta \notin [0.02, 0.50] or the \mathrm{arsinh} form is rejected at p < 0.001 Falsification of the direct identification. Either chromaticity projection decouples retinal perception from the Skein metric, or the q-chromaticity construction does not lift to macroscopic color perception via the standard functor.
